# Are.na

Are.na is a platform for collecting, organizing, and connecting ideas, images, links, and other creative research.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/arena/.

## Actions

- **Add To Channels**: Add an existing Are.na block or channel to one or more target channels without duplicating the underlying resource.
- **Create Channel**: Create a user-owned Are.na channel, closed by default, and return its stable numeric ID and generated slug.
- **Delete Channel**: Permanently delete one Are.na channel the authenticated user is allowed to destroy.
- **Get Block** (read-only): Get the details of one Are.na block by ID, including its subtype, content, source, creator, and metadata.
- **Get Channel** (read-only): Get an Are.na channel by numeric ID or slug, including visibility, counts, owner, and the current user's permissions.
- **Get Current User** (read-only): Return the identity and account details for the authenticated Are.na user.
- **Get My Feed** (read-only): Return one page of the authenticated user's personalized Are.na activity feed, newest first.
- **List Channel Contents** (read-only): Return one page of blocks and nested channels from an Are.na channel, with optional sorting and contributor filtering.
- **Remove From Channel**: Remove one block or nested channel placement from an Are.na channel.
- **Update Channel**: Update selected fields of an Are.na channel the authenticated user can edit.
